_note: CUST-HV V9d-4 — commerce firewall (V0 §14.3). A hostile document: every scope the production normalizer accepts (document tokens, branding, header, footer, contact, whatsapp, social, verification, sbc, apps, navigation, pagePresentation, announcements, palette, homepage sections, section content, section design, design.cards, nested items) carries commercial keys (price, discount, stock, availability, tax, total, currency, sku, quantity, shipping fee / amount, freight, delivery fee, offer status, coupon code, cost). After normalisation NO such key may survive anywhere, and no injected value may be reachable. Shared by PHP StorefrontPresentationNormalizer and both TS twins (normalizePresentationConfig). `forbiddenKeyPattern` matches the exact value-bearing commercial key names (anchored); `allowedKeys` are presentation controls V0 §14.3 allows (position / colour role / size step of price, stock or badge text) and must never match, so a legitimate future control is not rejected by the scan. The pattern is two clauses: the exact names above, plus any key that ENDS in a value noun (price / cost / total / amount / fee), so composed names such as unitPrice, taxAmount, shippingCost, checkoutTotal and subtotal are denied while position / colour-role / size controls (pricePosition, stockTextSize…) are not.
